title: [Master] Incorrect Payables Account Selected for Unrealized Gain/Loss in Multi-Posting Group FCY Applications.
summary: Foreign currency unrealized gain/loss posting now selects the correct payables account when multiple posting groups are used, fixing an issue where wrong accounts were chosen during multi-posting group transactions.
key_points: Fixes selection of the payables account for unrealized gain/loss in FCY applications that involve multiple posting groups
Same change applied to W1 and the APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, IT, NA, NO and RU layers
Adds tests in the Test Bank Payment Application codeunit
